page.notes: The page is a single column with no marginal notes. The last word "man-" is a line-end hyphenation that continues on the next page. Words in the Greek phrase are reproduced from the scan as best legible; the Greek line "φιλοπμία δεινὸν κακὸν" is a doubtful reading and should be checked against the original. Several letters in the body are faint (e.g. "Argathelienfi", "Infularum") and were read as printed. The word "amenta" in "quædam j amenta" is printed in black letter and marked as <bl>; "j" is probably a printed "i" of "insania" split by a damaged letter, and is left as printed. Possible printing errors ("afflectas", "Rollensis") are kept as printed.
